description: Ministry of Industries - Authorize the Purpose for Which the Society Known as " Clinical Travel Medicine Association" Situated No. 275/75/9C Prof. Stanly Wijesundawa Mw. Colombo 07
categorisation: This gazette notification exercises powers under the Societies Ordinance (a legal framework) to authorize a society's purpose and grant exemptions from specific legal provisions. It deals with regulatory matters and statutory instruments, falling clearly under Legal/Regulatory classification rather than government personnel or structural changes.
